entities.title: Required Documents for Business Visa Application
entities.summary: This page lists detailed required documents for a Schengen business visa application, including passport, Videx application form, health insurance, invitation letters, financial evidence and other supporting documents.
eligibility: passport must be valid for at least three months after the end of desired visa
passport must be signed by holder
minimum health insurance cover of €30000 covering all Schengen countries
must disclose all previous visa refusals; failure constitutes fraud and automatic grounds for refusal
required_documents: Current passport and copies of all previous passports and visas
Signed original Videx visa application form
Two biometric passport photos (not older than six months)
Health insurance policy (signed original and copy, minimum €30000 cover, all Schengen countries)
Invitation and supporting documents (original invitation letter not older than 3 months, on company/organisation letterhead)
Hotel bookings for whole duration of stay
Business reference letter (original, issued by company in Pakistan)
FRC (Family Registration Certificate), Marriage Certificate (if applicable), Birth Certificate (for minor applicants)
List of relatives living abroad (signed original)
application_process: Fill out application on Videx online application system, print and sign
Submit all required documents in listed order, in A4 copy format
Attend appointment as confirmed by appointment email
important_notes: Applications can be immediately rejected if any document is missing
Processing only starts once application submitted in full
Visa Section can request additional documents at any time
Trade fair exhibitors must provide stall rental confirmation, invoice and proof of payment
Trade fair visitors must provide entrance tickets or confirmation from fair organiser
Unsigned passports are invalid under Pakistani law and cannot receive visa

min_income_threshold.notes: Personal and company financial evidence required but no fixed numeric threshold specified
